text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — post-launch 'sieve' for next sprint. We shipped v1.3 last week. Priya flagged multiple customer asks + a few regressions. Need a short prioritized plan: what must land this sprint vs what gets deferred.
Priya (CS): Customers: ACME and Novi reported two enhancement asks (batch toggle + templating) and 3 bug reports. ACME says batch toggle affects latency for their 95th pct flows.
Tom (Eng): Can you list the 3 bugs?
Priya (CS): Sure — short list: 1) model timeouts on >8k token chats (seen with ACME) 2) embedding drift when retrying with same input 3) UI pagination off-by-one on history view.
Ling (SRE): Timeout sounds P0 if it's reproducible and impacts ACME production. What's the failure mode — OOM, kernel crash, or request queueing?
Priya (CS): For ACME it's request failures with 504s; logs show long tail on kv-cache hits during long chats.
Tom (Eng): Okay. Proposal: P0 (timeouts) + embedding drift (P1) get into sprint. UI pagination (P2) can be a follow-on patch. For ENH ACME batch toggle — we can do a server-side flag behind a feature-flag and ship as a canary if we have 1 engineer for ~3 days.
Mateo (Design): If we expose a batch toggle, UX needs a simple affordance and copy. I can sketch a microflow + tooltip in one day.
Ling (SRE): Note: batch toggle increases average GPU burst — need capacity knob in routing. If we push to canary, set routing policy to 'burst-limited' and add usage alerts.
triage-bot: Automated impact summary: ACME = 12% of hosted qps for the last 24h; errors correlated with long-chat sessions (p95 latency up 3.2x).
Aisha (PM): Thanks. Let's do a lightweight impact table and decide.
Aisha (PM): ```
PRIO Matrix:
- BUG-112: long-chat timeouts — P0 — fix in-sprint (owner: Tom)
- BUG-118: embedding drift on retry — P1 — in-sprint (owner: Ling/Tom)
- BUG-121: UI history pagination — P2 — next sprint (owner: Mateo)
- ENH-089: batch toggle (ACME) — P1 — canary if design + infra + 0.5FTE available
- ENH-092: prompt templates UI — P2 — backlog
```
Tom (Eng): I can take BUG-112 and pair with Ling for instrumentation. Quick plan: add additional timeout metrics, guard KV-cache reads with circuit breaker, and add retry bucket. Should be 3-4 dev days + 1 day testing.
Ling (SRE): I'll add infra story: routing policy change + alerting + synthetic test for long-chat flows. 2 days. Need canary tag for ACME.
Mateo (Design): I'll send a small mock for pagination fix + the batch-toggle microcopy by EOD.
Priya (CS): I'll coordinate with ACME — ask them to enable verbose logs for 48h and approve canary if we go that route.
Aisha (PM): Decision: Ship fixes for BUG-112 and BUG-118 in this sprint. BUG-121 + ENH-092 deferred. ENH-089 (batch toggle) — target canary: conditional, only if we can get infra + design commitments by tomorrow noon. Otherwise move ENH-089 to next sprint.
Tom (Eng): sgtm. I'll open the two bug PRs today and tag reviewers.
triage-bot: Created tickets: BUG-112, BUG-118, BUG-121, ENH-089-canary, ENH-092-backlog. Links: https://rwd/issues/112 https://rwd/issues/118
Ling (SRE): I'll schedule a 30m canary playbook meeting if Priya hears ACME ok.
Priya (CS): ACME just replied: "we can enable canary for a 6-hour window next Tue morning". Do we accept?
Aisha (PM): Yes — accept conditional canary. Action items: Tom + Ling — fix + infra for P0/P1. Mateo — microcopy + pagination mock. Priya — coordinate ACME canary window. I'll update the roadmap board.
Tom (Eng): Noted. I'll add a quick rollback test and make the deployment toggled.
Mateo (Design): Will drop mocks in Figma under /post-launch/sprint-sieve today.
Aisha (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene on Thursday 11am if there are blockers. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): +1
Ling (SRE): +1
Tom (Eng): +1
